project.title: Iris
project.description: A fully offline voice assistant for Apple Silicon: wake word detection, streaming speech-to-text, LLM reasoning, and text-to-speech, all running on-device with zero cloud dependency. Uses sherpa-onnx for wake word and STT, llama.cpp on Metal for reasoning, and Kokoro for TTS, plus a physics-based memory graph for concept association.
project.progress: Core pipeline (wake word to STT to LLM to TTS) runs end-to-end offline on Apple Silicon. Memory graph and agent behaviors under active development.

project.title: Iskra
project.description: A single-binary Go CLI for managing git across many repositories: AI-generated commit messages (Ollama, OpenAI, or Claude), bulk multi-repo sync and clone, status overviews, and a full single-repo toolkit for switching, rebasing, stashing, and cherry-picking. Successor to Zvezda, rebuilt for speed and simplicity.
project.progress: Tagged releases (v2.1.1), CI, man page, and full CHANGELOG. Actively maintained daily-driver tool.

project.title: sketchybar
project.description: A Tokyo Night-themed SketchyBar configuration for macOS, built on the SbarLua framework, with multi-monitor AeroSpace workspace integration, live WiFi/battery/CPU/media widgets, and a custom icon font. My most-starred repository on GitHub.
project.progress: Actively maintained daily-driver setup with a fully automated 5-stage installer.

project.title: Nvim-config
project.description: A batteries-included Neovim configuration: 28 language servers wired through native vim.lsp.config with no nvim-lspconfig boilerplate, blink.cmp completion, Treesitter, Harpoon, LazyGit, and Trouble diagnostics, plus Jupyter and LaTeX support.
project.progress: Actively maintained daily-driver configuration, refined continuously.

project.title: Mew
project.description: A strict C11 reimplementation of cat: zero dependencies, raw POSIX syscalls only, full POSIX flag handling (-A, -b, -e, -E, -n, -s, -t, -T, -u, -v, --color), and a byte-for-byte test suite run in CI against real cat on Ubuntu and macOS with gcc and clang, ASAN/UBSAN-checked in debug builds.
project.progress: Feature-complete and tagged (v2.0.0), with full CI, sanitizer checks, and test suite. Deliberately small and correct.

project.title: Setka
project.description: A Go network-traffic visualizer that captures live TCP/UDP connections via libpcap, aggregates them into flows, and streams them to a browser over WebSocket in real time.
project.progress: Full pipeline runs end-to-end today: real packet capture, flow aggregation, and live WebSocket broadcast to a web UI. Process-name attribution is still a basic port lookup.

project.title: Briz
project.description: An LLM-powered CLI that reads a messy directory's file tree and reorganizes it into a logical structure using a local Ollama model, with a dry-run preview before anything moves. No hand-written filename rules.
project.progress: Functional CLI with dry-run preview and configurable rules.

project.title: NF-ToolBox
project.description: The license-management backbone for the NF Software tool line: an API server handling auth, license activation and renewal, and Stripe billing webhooks on Postgres, a CLI for end users, and an embeddable Go package for entitlement checks in other NF tools.
project.progress: Full REST API surface implemented and documented: auth, license activation, renewal, and Stripe webhooks, deployed on Fly.io.

project.title: GymBuddy
project.description: A SwiftUI iOS app that gamifies learning exercise form and anatomy through category-based quizzes, streaks, a visual exercise gallery browsable by muscle group, and a stats dashboard.
project.progress: Core quiz, gallery, and stats features implemented and functional.

project.title: EnronBox
project.description: A full-stack NLP research platform for the Enron email corpus: zero-shot classification, summarization, and emotion detection using transformer models (BART, DistilBERT), with GPU acceleration and Ollama-generated responses, served through a Flask API, React web UI, and Tauri desktop app.
project.progress: Mature research platform with classification, summarization, sentiment analysis, and both web and desktop clients complete.

project.title: Frisian Draught
project.description: A full-featured Frisian Draughts (checkers variant) desktop game built with JavaFX. Led a 5-developer team implementing Minimax and Deep Q-Network AI opponents, local multiplayer, tutorials, light/dark themes, and sound, with installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
project.progress: Feature-complete: AI opponents, local multiplayer, tutorials, themes, and packaged installers for all major platforms.

project.title: PotPotGolf
project.description: A 3D physics-based mini-golf game built from scratch with LWJGL and raw OpenGL: procedurally generated terrain, sand and water hazards, HDR lighting and a custom shader pipeline, and Minimax-driven AI opponents validated with A* pathfinding. Won a best-project award.
project.progress: Feature-complete: full 3D engine, physics, procedural terrain, and AI opponents. Won best-project award at Maastricht University.

project.title: ShadowedHunter
project.description: A dark, fast-paced metroidvania game with combat and puzzles. Originally prototyped in Java/Swing, now being rebuilt in Unity 6 with the Universal Render Pipeline as the primary direction going forward.
project.progress: Early-stage Unity rebuild underway; legacy Java/Swing prototype kept for reference.

project.title: QueryCrust
project.description: A full-stack SQL database query management tool with a Flask and MySQL backend and a React frontend for building, running, and visualizing complex database queries.
project.progress: Complete and fully functional, with schema migrations managed through Flask-Migrate.

project.title: Zarya.nvim
project.description: A Neovim plugin providing a floating UI to control Apple Music from inside the editor: track info, playback controls, volume, and a Telescope-powered playlist picker.
project.progress: Fully functional and polished, entirely original work.

project.title: BitVoyager
project.description: A browser-based coding education platform teaching Bash and Python through story-driven terminal missions, with a real xterm.js terminal emulator, sandboxed execution, and adaptive task recommendations.
project.progress: Bash and Python tracks functional end-to-end. JavaScript/Rust/Go tracks, auth, and multiplayer challenges on the roadmap.

project.title: Psycho
project.description: A professional marketing website for a certified psychopedagogue, covering services, background, and approach with a modern, animated interface, live on a custom domain.
project.progress: Live in production on a custom domain, with ongoing styling and accessibility updates.

project.title: Lucie-study
project.description: A French-language history and geography revision app that consolidates several standalone study pages into one Vue application with a shared quiz engine, glossary, and timeline, buildable as a single offline-ready HTML file.
project.progress: Content migration and quiz engine complete, verified against the original source material.

project.title: NF-Software
project.description: The landing page and product hub for NF Software, showcasing the tool line and the NF-ToolBox ecosystem, with a small Fastify backend serving content.
project.progress: Functional landing page and backend, evolving alongside the NF Software product line.

project.title: Astrotop
project.description: A Rust system dashboard aiming for predictive load forecasting on top of real-time CPU, memory, and network telemetry collected via the sysinfo crate.
project.progress: Real-time stats collection works today; predictive forecasting is not yet implemented.

project.title: Derevo
project.description: A planned syntax-aware code search tool intended to use Tree-sitter for structural search across programming languages, rather than plain text matching.
project.progress: Early scaffold stage — architecture named and shaped, parsing and indexing not yet implemented.
